action.text: Request confirmation of the next watch's payment before proposing staffing commitments that depend on those funds.

rationale.text: Our duty is to keep the beacons staffed, not to mistake an unconfirmed payment report for money we can spend. We should settle that uncertainty before making a commitment.

uncertainties.text: Whether the council has actually arranged payment and whether reserve funds are available remain unknown.

communication.text: Please confirm the payment arrangements for the next beacon watch. We need that confirmation before proposing staffing commitments that depend on the funds.
